name: The Master Theorem
description: How to read off the running time of divide-and-conquer recurrences of the form T(n) = aT(n/b) + f(n), with its three cases, a worked example, and where it doesn't apply.
highlights: Compare f(n) against n^(log_b a) to pick one of three cases
Worked example: T(n) = 3T(n/2) + n² is Θ(n²)
